verdict.rationale: Codex CLI/cloud is designed exactly for this: explore code, plan a change, edit files across a repo, run tools, inspect diffs, and open a PR, plus delegate longer tasks and run in parallel cloud environments — all confirming multi-file plain-language implementation/fix workflows. Community evidence corroborates real-world use fixing bugs and completing tasks, though with mixed quality/reliability reports. Missing for 10: independent benchmark showing consistent multi-file correctness across large repos, and some community reports of struggles/slowness temper full confidence.
